basic_steps: Gather in rhythmic formation at the temple grounds holding a khukuri, sword, or khuda
Swing and display the weapon rhythmically to the sound of Panchebaja
Clash weapons with fellow devotees while chanting 'Wakkhai Wa'
teaching.formation: Group gather at religious shrines and temple grounds
teaching.level_notes: Requires handling of traditional edged weapons; physical demonstrations have been reduced in some areas due to safety concerns.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic accompaniment provided by Panchebaja instruments
